New York 
Economic activity has expanded modestly. Labor mar-
kets remained tight and wages continued to grow mod-
erately. Input cost pressures have remained fairly wide-
spread, while selling prices have continued to increase 
at a modest pace. Housing markets have improved 
somewhat except at the high end, while commercial real 
estate markets have been steady to slacker. 
 
The Beige Book ■ April 2017
